_comment: Curated voiced battle lines. voice = vo_line file id (sound/voice/vo_line/{voice}_{lang}.scd); yell = row holding the same line in sheet (default NpcYell; InstanceContentTextData for duty dialogue); the text is read at runtime in the client language. The voice id is NOT 8200000 + yell. Pairs are proven offline: speech recognition of the ja and en audio must each pick the same row with a clear margin (see docs/acceptance/voice.md), plus the earlier duration/script-constant pairs. gender = speaker voice (age/gender model + pitch/formant LDA + speaker clusters agreeing). age = young/adult/elderly from the age model smoothed per speaker cluster; coarse and only a preference at runtime. extended = pair found by speech recognition (provenance only). fx = studio-processed voice (hall/echo tail, layered boss or primal voice; measured from the ja and en audio, see docs/acceptance/voice.md): never given to a human speaker; monsters and demihumans speak only these. pja/pen = speaker persona in VoicePersonas.json for the ja/en recording; on an fx line it is a boss persona (ja-bNN/en-bNN, fx lines grouped by speaker cluster).
